Package com.sfuparkingmayhem.game

package com.sfuparkingmayhem.game
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Barrier
    This class extends StaticEntity class and contains a constructor for a Barrier object.
    Board
    This class implements the ActionListener and KeyListener and implements the JPanel classes.
    Coin
    This class extends the Reward class.
    ConcordOfficer
    A ConcordOfficer is a MovingEntity that chases the MainCharacter.
    Cone
    A cone barrier that acts as an obstacle in the game.
    Dimensions
    This Dimensions class extends contains the following methods: a constructor and getters to get the values of the ROWS, COLUMNS, and CELL_SIZE attributes.
    Entity
    This class provides methods for different entities MovingEntity and StaticEntity to get x and y coordinates to be placed on the board, getting the entities' images and drawing them on the board.
    EntityCoordinates
    This EntityCoordinates class contains 2D arraylists to hold the X and Y coordinates of the StaticEntities and a constructor.
    EntityLists
    Class holding all lists of all types of entities on the board.
    Game
    This class initializes windows (win/lose/Main Menu/Instructions) to play the game.
    GameTimer
    Class for the timer in the game that counts up while the player plays and displays when they win.
    LostNote
    This class extends Reward class and contains a constructor, getImage method to get the png of this LostNote from resources directory, and method to randomly generate X and Y coordinates for this LostNote
    Main
    This main class instantiates a new Game.
    MainCharacter
    This MainCharacter class extends MovingEntity class and contains the following methods: a constructor to instantiate a MainCharacter, a method to get the image of this MainCharacter, and a move method allowing this MainCharacter to move Left,Right,Up,and Down on game board.
    MovingEntity
    This MovingEntity class extends Entity class and contains the following methods: a constructor to instantiate a MovingEntity, and a method to move the entity.
    ParkedCar
    This class extends the Barrier class and represents a ParkedCar.
    Reward
    This Reward class extends StaticEntity class and contains the following methods: a constructor to instantiate a Reward, and a method to check if the Reward is collected.
    Score
    This Score class keeps track of the player's score and contains a constructor and methods to get and add/subtract/reset the value of this score.
    StaticEntity
    This class extends Entity class, and this class contains a constructor and a getImage method to retrieve the png from resources directory
